race.comment: STANDARD DEVIATION (6) finds an easier contest fourth up and no excuses today from the good draw. Three weeks between runs when he held his ground to the line with a close-up fourth over 1900m at Canterbury. Ticks all the right boxes with J Mac aboard. SNEAKY CHOICE (7) underrated mare who maps well today at her fifth run for the prep. Savaged the line two back when second at Warwick Farm. Jumped in class and chipped away late for a plugging fifth over the 1600m at Warwick Farm in BM78 grade. Winning jockey hops back aboard and sure to be thereabouts. LEICA STORM (4) placed at the trip and deserves another chance today. Shouldered the 58.5kg with a close-up fifth over 1600m at Warwick Farm. Will roll forward and give plenty of cheek. BOTANICAL BOY (1) is starting to hit his straps after launching late with the 60kg to salute as fav in a tight finish over 1600m at Warwick Farm. Adept in all conditions and keep safe.
